goal: Search flights from LON to NYC leaving next Monday and returning after a week for 2 passengers.
guardrails: Do not charge payment or confirm a reservation.

toolSnapshot.name: listFlights
toolSnapshot.description: Returns the flights currently visible on the results page after all filters have been applied.

toolSnapshot.name: resetFilters
toolSnapshot.description: Resets all filters to their default values.

toolSnapshot.name: searchFlights
toolSnapshot.description: Searches for flights with the given parameters.

origin.description: City or airport IATA code for the origin. Prefer city IATA codes when a specific airport is not provided. Example: 'RIO' for 'Rio de Janeiro'

destination.description: City or airport IATA code for the destination airport. Prefer city IATA codes when a specific airport is not provided. Example: 'RIO' for 'Rio de Janeiro'

tripType.description: The trip type. Can be "one-way" or "round-trip".

outboundDate.description: The outbound date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

inboundDate.description: The inbound date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

stops.description: The list of stop counts to filter by.

airlines.description: The list of airlines IATA codes to filter by.

origins.description: The list of origin airports to filter by, using the 3 letter IATA code.

destinations.description: The list of destination airports to filter by, using the 3 letter IATA code.

departureTime.description: The departure time range in minutes from the start of the day (0-1439). For example, to filter between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM, use [540, 1020].

arrivalTime.description: The arrival time range in minutes from the start of the day (0-1439). For example, to filter between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM, use [540, 1020].

flightIds.description: The list of flight IDs to filter by.

content.text: A new flight search was started.
